caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden piece of furniture, specifically a brown table or small desk, placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The table has a rectangular shape, with a decorative wood grain pattern visible on its surfaces. It features two main sections: a slightly protruding, narrower top drawer set above a larger lower section, both with visible keyholes and round, dark metal drawer pulls. The table stands on four slender, turned legs, each with carved details near the top and bottom. The wood appears to have a slightly glossy finish, showing areas of wear with small white patches or scuffs. The artist's signature, "Willoughby Lans," appears in the lower right corner of the image. No other objects or background elements are present in the composition.
title: Georgian Desk
